iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear risk edges higher: Axios-linked reporting says Washington demanded changes to a draft Iran nuclear deal, Tehran says the US must accept enrichment rights or the conflict continues, and Reuters carry-forward still frames highly enriched uranium as Tehran’s core leverage. The 60 percent enrich technical driver remains active; no top-level jump or device event surfaced.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR / GULF
iran_conventional.notes: Iran/Gulf conventional risk remains imminent: Washington Post, Euronews, Times of Israel, and The Independent reported a US strike disabling a commercial ship trying to breach the Iran blockade, while diplomatic talk continues. Hormuz restricted conditions, military buildup, and oil infrastructure risk remain active; no verified total closure surfaced.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon is the sharpest fresh mover: Reuters, BBC, NPR, Washington Post, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, and NYT report Israel seized Beaufort Castle and pushed deeper into Lebanon while Hezbollah fire continued. This is force deploy behavior and strikes despite ceasefire; escalation risk is rising.

turkey.name: TURKEY / EAST MED
turkey.notes: Turkey/East Mediterranean remains deterrent-low: RSS fallback found a report on a long-range cruise system, but no fresh interstate clash, official atomic warning, or crisis-level mobilization surge. Risk holds near baseline.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan rises into critical-low: WION, Business Recorder, MSN, and DD News report Army Chief readiness rhetoric around Operation Sindoor 2.0 and air-defence displays. This supports a military buildup signal, but no confirmed fresh cross-border strike surfaced.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO remains imminent by strategic-warning posture and Ukraine spillover: PBS and regional feeds describe Putin escalation pressure, Medvedev warned of a new Chernobyl after Zaporizhzhia claims, and Romania drone spillover keeps NATO response risk live. Nuclear rhetoric remains active; no direct NATO-Russia combat exchange confirmed.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan stays elevated but below crisis threshold: SCMP says China dialed down rhetoric at Shangri-La while risks persist, and other feeds cite Scarborough patrols and Taiwan-related friction. No fresh blockade, amphibious surge, or official atomic warning crossed threshold.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: North Korea reaches imminent threshold: AOL and regional feeds report North Korea fires missiles as South Korea seeks nuclear-powered submarines, plus claims of AI-guided rockets. The missile launch signal remains active; no device event surfaced.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine/NATO spillover remains the top systemic driver: Al Jazeera reports Ukrainian drone hits on Russian targets, ISW describes continuing offensive pressure, CBS and UNITED24 report Zelensky warning Russia is testing NATO with drones, and the Romania incident remains live. Military buildup and nuclear rhetoric stay active while diplomatic talk is only a partial offset.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan remains imminent: Canberra Times reports Pakistan declared open war as it bombs Afghan cities and another strike near Bagram was thwarted, while DD News carries Taliban casualty claims from a Kabul hospital strike. This sustains the military buildup signal.
